features.name: HRMS & ERP Handshake
features.description: Manage automated interval, surgical, and bulk manual data synchronization.

features.name: Persona Architect (RBAC)

features.name: Bulk Import Tool

features.name: Unit-Level Analytics

features.name: Global Leaderboard Governance
